Fixes CITATION.cff name-particle leak across the org. Per the CFF spec, name-particle is for surname infixes (de/van/von) — not initials. Merges "P." into given-names as "Stephen P." and adds canonical email stephen@szlholdings.com.

Part of the Series-A doctrine cleanup (see audit report).
title: doctrine(citation): merge P. into given-names; add email

## feat(doctrine): DOCTRINE_V2 + T01/T02 STATUS

This PR adopts **Doctrine v2** for `szl-holdings`, replacing the previous rubric with a stricter, fully conjunctive evaluation framework.

### What's included

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `DOCTRINE_V2.md` | Full doctrine document — 9 canonical axes, raised thresholds |
| `docs/doctrine/zenodo_metadata.json` | Zenodo metadata for Λ DOI mint (pending author confirm) |
| `docs/squad-tracks/01_status.md` | T01 squad-track STATUS |
| `docs/squad-tracks/02_status.md` | T02 squad-track STATUS |
| `docs/squad-tracks/T01_doctrine_self_grade.md` | T01 self-grade against Doctrine v2 |
| `docs/squad-tracks/T02_doctrine_self_grade.md` | T02 self-grade against Doctrine v2 |

### Doctrine v2 key changes

- **9 canonical axes** (up from prior rubric): reasoning, honesty, calibration, moralGrounding, measurabilityHonesty, robustness, delegation, transparency, alignment
- **All axes ≥ 0.90** (conjunctive AND — any single axis failure below threshold rejects)
- **`moralGrounding` + `measurabilityHonesty` ≥ 0.95** (elevated floor for ethical integrity axes)
- **5× replay byte-identical** requirement for deterministic verification
- Threshold enforcement is conjunctive: no partial credit across axes

### Λ DOI mint

The Zenodo DOI for DOCTRINE_V2 is pending final `confirm_action` by Stephen P. Lutar Jr. (ORCID: 0009-0001-0110-4173). The `docs/doctrine/zenodo_metadata.json` file contains the prepared metadata for submission.

### Related

- Companion security hardening PR: **#28** (`chore/security-10-10`) — this PR is **separate** and does not conflict with #28.

---

*Author: Stephen P. Lutar Jr. <stephen@szlholdings.com> · ORCID [0009-0001-0110-4173](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-0110-4173)*
title: feat(doctrine): DOCTRINE_V2 + T01/T02 STATUS
